name: io.github.musharna/breedsim-mcp
title: breedsim-mcp
description: Breeding-scheme simulation via AlphaSimR — returns distributions, never a single run. NEEDS R + AlphaSimR + libtirpc-dev on the host: rpy2 publishes no Linux wheels, so installation compiles it from source and fails with 'cannot find -ltirpc' without them. Read the README's 'Install tax' section before installing.

environmentVariables.name: OMP_NUM_THREADS
environmentVariables.description: Pinned to '1' at import so AlphaSimR results are reproducible; overriding it makes runs non-deterministic and the server reports that in every response.
